system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform action: Sends OTP for SDRF/NDRF authentication. Here are my details: my mobile_number is 9876543873, my aadhaar_number is 100020008128.

function.name: sdrfndrf_submit_claim
function.description: Submits a formal relief claim based on a reported damage event. Transitions claim_status to 'submitted'. Damage must be reported first. SDRF/NDRF relief is separate from PMFBY insurance. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve claims. Fails if damage not reported or duplicate claim exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

claim_id.description: Unique identifier of the relief claim generated during reporting.

function.name: sdrfndrf_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for SDRF/NDRF authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.
